confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable. Lodging is less certain because of neighborhood, booking-date and July peak-season variation, and FIFA World Cup 2026 matches in the LA area may have lifted some rates. Cocktail and wine anchors were cross-checked against the beer anchor. The FX value comes from a search-result summary of the RBA overview page (as at 4pm, 13 Oct 2026). I did not open that page directly, and no second source confirmed it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Based on general knowledge of major US West Coast metro price levels, roughly in line with San Francisco and Seattle for restaurants and drinks, with a July peak-season uplift applied to lodging.
